hook.headline:
GPT-5.6 dropped today.
Fable 5's already here.
which do you actually use?
hook.subline: (save this before you waste a month on the wrong one.)

items.take: For 95% of your work, either one crushes it.
items.defense: The truth nobody posting about this will tell you: Claude and ChatGPT are both so good now the 'which wins' fight barely matters.

items.take: Open ChatGPT (GPT-5.6) when you want one great all-rounder.
items.defense: It's already in your pocket — and the new free tier just got a serious upgrade.

items.take: Open Claude (Fable 5) when it's a long, messy project.
items.defense: Big docs, deep research, work you hand off and check later. It goes further without hand-holding.

items.take: The model was never your bottleneck. Your prompting is.
items.defense: A pro on ChatGPT beats a beginner on the best model alive.

cta.headline:

instead of chasing every model?
cta.slogan: it grades your prompts. 5 min a day.
